d: We are looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and results-driven Business Data Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting business data to identify trends, evaluate performance, uncover business opportunities, and provide actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and organizational growth.
Collect, clean, organize, and analyze business data from multiple sources.
Interpret complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, business opportunities, and performance gaps.
Develop and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools.
Monitor business performance and track key performance indicators (KPIs).
Analyze sales, customer, financial, and operational data to support business decisions.
Prepare regular analytical reports and presentations for management and relevant stakeholders.
Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend data-driven process improvements.
Conduct trend analysis, forecasting, and performance evaluations to support business planning.
Collaborate with sales, marketing, finance, and operations teams to understand business requirements.
Validate data accuracy, maintain data integrity, and ensure consistency across reporting systems.
Translate analytical findings into practical recommendations and business strategies.
Support management in evaluating business performance and measuring the effectiveness of initiatives.
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Administration, Economics, or a relevant field.
1–3 years of experience in business data analysis, data analytics, business intelligence, or a related role.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, and data analysis.
Working knowledge of SQL for data extraction and database querying.
Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools.
Strong understanding of data cleaning, data validation, reporting, and analytical methodologies.
Excellent analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings effectively.
Strong report writing, presentation, and communication skills.
High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple analytical assignments.
A data-driven individual with strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities.
Someone who can transform raw data into meaningful business insights.
Strong problem-solving skills with a business-oriented mindset.
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
A proactive professional who can work independently and collaboratively.
Someone passionate about using data to improve business performance and support strategic growth.
